item.title: Board of Directors Announces Retirement of NAAF President & CEO Nicole Friedland
item.description: The Board of Directors of the National Alopecia Areata Foundation (NAAF) announced today that Nicole Friedland will retire as President & CEO from NAAF on February 6, 2026, after four years leading the organization and 37 years of transformative work improving health, and access to healthcare, for people around the globe.
